finalText:
The bug was in the page calculation. Since pages are 1-indexed (page 1 is the first batch), you need to subtract 1 before multiplying by `perPage`. The code was using `page * perPage` instead of `(page - 1) * perPage`, which offset every page by one — page 1 returned page 2's data, page 2 returned page 3's data, and so on.

Fixed with one change to paginate.js. All 5 tests now pass.
